title: Design and deploy a Dataverse model
subtitle: Shape the model, define rules, test it, then move changes through separate environments.

steps.title: Model around business concepts
steps.evidence: Build D365 CE data models around business concepts, then use standard Dataverse tables where they fit

steps.title: Define ownership and record rules
steps.evidence: Define relationship behaviour, data owners, system-of-record rules, stable integration identifiers, and conflict handling.

steps.title: Document and test the model
steps.evidence: Document the model, test realistic queries and updates

steps.title: Deploy across environments
steps.evidence: deploy changes through solutions across development, test, and production environments.
